title: A Letter, a Membrane, and the Hairy I
source: Original interpretation of Zamyatin's tenth record in the 1924 translation
content_note: Intimate tension and non-graphic depiction of aggressive behavior

scenes.title: 01 · The Inkblot and the Letter
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: I feel purified after yesterday. Then the controller tells me there is a letter.
scenes.story: Following the Cube ceremony, D-503 believes his mind has been cleansed of disorder. In the glass building's lobby, the supervisor U records departures and hints at a letter that has passed through the State's inspection process.
scenes.observation: U maintains a lobby register and tells D-503 of official correspondence.
scenes.inference: State inspection of correspondence demonstrates meaningful privacy.
scenes.question: What does the controlled letter reveal?
choices: Communication is subject to institutional inspection.
The recipient freely consented to that inspection.
reply: Correct: this keeps an observation separate from the stronger claim.
The literary record does not establish that conclusion.

scenes.title: 02 · An Official Appointment
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: An approved notice has arrived. Why should it frighten me?
scenes.story: A sanctioned notification informs D-503 that I-330 has registered him for an intimate visit at 21:00. Memories of the Ancient House, his unfiled report, and O-90 make the administrative notice emotionally complicated.
scenes.observation: I-330 registered the visit; D-503 receives the approved notice.
scenes.inference: Formal authorization proves that both people have no doubts or conflicting desires.
scenes.question: What is confirmed by the notice?
reply: Correct: this keeps an observation separate from the stronger claim.
The literary record does not establish that conclusion.

scenes.title: 03 · Twenty-Forty-Five
scenes.speaker: NARRATOR · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: The transparent buildings look as fragile as D-503's certainty.
scenes.story: Despite telling himself he does not want to see I-330, D-503 goes to her apartment. The northern night gives the glass city a strange greenish appearance. His pulse and anxiety contradict the calm he associates with his ideal Number.
scenes.observation: D-503 travels to the appointment while visibly anxious.
scenes.inference: Actual attendance proves complete emotional agreement.
scenes.question: Which two records coexist?
choices: He goes, while his private feelings remain conflicted.
His outward action resolves his inner conflict.
reply: Correct: this keeps an observation separate from the stronger claim.
The literary record does not establish that conclusion.

scenes.title: 04 · The Unfiled Report
scenes.speaker: I-330 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: You never reported what happened at the Ancient House.
scenes.story: I-330 reminds D-503 that the forty-eight-hour reporting period has expired without his complaint to the Guardians. She can now invoke the rule against him. D-503 feels trapped by the consequences of his earlier inaction.
scenes.observation: The reporting deadline has passed and D-503 has not filed the accusation.
scenes.inference: A sincere intention to report counts as completed compliance.
scenes.question: What is the event-level fact?
choices: A deadline expired without the report.
His earlier self-description fulfills the duty.
reply: Correct: this keeps an observation separate from the stronger claim.
The literary record does not establish that conclusion.

scenes.title: 05 · The Engineer Becomes an Ear
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: The curtains are closed. I can hear everything and understand almost nothing.
scenes.story: I-330 lowers all the curtains. As D-503 listens to her movement behind him, he remembers designing a membrane for recording street conversations for the Guardians. He becomes intensely aware of sound, heartbeat, and the limits of his own interpretation.
scenes.observation: Curtains close; D-503 hears private movements and recalls surveillance engineering.
scenes.inference: Recording sound gives direct access to another person's intentions.
scenes.question: What can a listening instrument establish?
choices: Audible events, not the complete meaning of private thought.
Every motive of the person being observed.
reply: Correct: this keeps an observation separate from the stronger claim.
The literary record does not establish that conclusion.

scenes.title: 06 · The Two Selves of D-503
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: The Number I claim to be and the person I feel myself becoming are not aligned.
scenes.story: I-330 appears in yellow old-fashioned clothes, drinks forbidden alcohol, and smokes. D-503 protests yet becomes overwhelmed by contradictory jealousy, attraction and fear. His behavior turns aggressive; I-330 pulls away. The scene is represented symbolically rather than depicting violence.
scenes.observation: State-prohibited acts, D-503's distress, his aggression, and I-330's withdrawal are distinct events.
scenes.inference: His feelings justify aggression or constitute final allegiance against the State.
scenes.question: What does the conflict demonstrate?
choices: His self-understanding has split, without excusing harmful behavior.
Any feeling of desire makes coercion acceptable.
reply: Correct: this keeps an observation separate from the stronger claim.
The literary record does not establish that conclusion.

scenes.title: 07 · Five Minutes to Curfew
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: The clock returns me to the old formula, but I cannot make myself sleep.
scenes.story: I-330 shows D-503 it is 22:25, five minutes before curfew. He flees, loses and retrieves his badge, senses possible footsteps but cannot identify a follower, and reaches home in time. That night, his attempts at self-command fail to bring sleep.
scenes.observation: He rushes home before curfew and subsequently cannot sleep.
scenes.inference: His fear proves he was followed or that all internal conflict has ended.
scenes.question: What remains for W011?
choices: Unresolved anxiety and an unverified impression of being followed.
A confirmed pursuer and fully restored psychological order.
reply: Correct: this keeps an observation separate from the stronger claim.
The literary record does not establish that conclusion.
